title: Welcome to The Disco Den
description:
The Disco Den is a vibrant, music-inspired tiny house just 15 minutes from Nashville Airport and 15 minutes from downtown. With colorful decor, funky lighting, and cozy furnishings, it sleeps 4 comfortably. Enjoy a kitchenette, Roku Smart TV, Wi-Fi, and a private outdoor fire pit. On-site parking for 2 vehicles. Perfect for couples or friends seeking a fun, laid-back escape outside the city, with all Nashville’s sights just a quick drive away. 

Book now for a unique Nashville experience!
